name: Auto-mark broken items as junk
description: Items you carry that are broken or completely worn out get the Junk mark.

name: Auto-mark empty cans, cups and bottles as junk
description: Empty cans, plastic cups and empty bottles get the Junk mark (it goes away when they are filled).

name: Auto-mark wet clothes as junk
description: Wet clothing you carry but do not wear gets the Junk mark until it is dry.
